narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as off |

The 8 warnings are still there. They are real deprecations, like `Buffer()` and `punycode`. None break the build.

Next: clear those deprecations if you want a silent log.
